per_candidate.id: s2:Urca cooling of the neutron star in the Cassiopeia A supernova remnant
s2:New Constraints on the Axion–Electron Coupling Constant for Solar Axions

rationale: None of the candidate papers directly investigate the influence of axion-photon and axion-nucleon coupling constants on hard X-ray emissions from neutron stars or the surface temperature evolution of Cassiopeia A. They focus on related topics such as axion production and detection in different astrophysical contexts.
